question: What is said in the glorious Bhairava Kula?
premises: it is said in Bhairava Kula
the teacher is well-prepared by five initiations
he transcends the lower stream following Trika scripture
inference: The true teacher transcends lower streams through five initiations.
plain_english: It is said in the glorious Bhairava Kula: the teacher, well-prepared by five initiations and transcending the lower stream, indeed follows Trika scripture.
